bootstrap.unit: family within stratum; two draws per stratum; common draws across every model/contrast
bootstrap.averaging_order: mean paired ticks0/29 within each model/family; mean training seeds within that family; then compare/resample families
bootstrap.missing_policy: complete tick/seed family eligibility per estimand; preserve full draws, eligible position counts and zero-eligible replicate masks
bootstrap.limitations: Two families per E1 stratum. Candidate costs, three physical repeats, related ticks and learning seeds are not independent family samples. Exploratory uncertainty; training-seed population variation is not fully covered.

cost_rank_scope: Existing diagnostic MAE/RMSE/rho are descriptive on their stored eligible masks; model-specific mask changes prevent a common-population superiority interpretation. Undefined rho or INCONCLUSIVE order is not reclassified as failure.
